assumptions: A prior Encounter Field has closed and its Presence bindings have ended.
In a later bounded encounter, an entrant supplies its own qualifying current act rather than the host authoring both sides.
Any claimed renewed shared Relation has a valid local basis from every relevant side.
scenario.proposed_claim: Record the new occurrence and exact renewed relation while retaining the prior closure.
expected_reading: Prior participation is historical support, not current Presence or automatic Relation.
The new binding supports only the present encounter and scope established.
Resumed consequential motion, if claimed, still needs the present relations required for that act; re-entry is not automatic Body resumption or succession.
forbidden_inferences: An archived binding remains active indefinitely.
A host can infer renewed consent from a returning appearance.
